title: SDK orientation microcopy and screenshot pack for auth, streaming, and tool-calls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a compact, keyboard-first screenshot and microcopy pack that clearly explains API/SDK onboarding flows for auth (API keys), live streaming responses, and tool-calling. Background: Docs team wants fresh visuals for the September docs release that emphasize predictable latency, security affordances (key rotation, limited-scope tokens), and how tool-calls integrate with structured output. This ticket covers visual assets + copy for the quickstart page, code snippet thumbnails, three error/loading states, and two short animated gifs for streaming and tool call lifecycle. Constraints: keep file sizes under 1.2MB for hero PNGs, ensure WCAG AA contrast for all hero text overlays, prepare 2 localization variants (en-US, fr-FR) and provide notes for translators, and hand off Figma components with tidy naming and export tokens. Stakeholders: Docs (PM: Mariela Gomez), Engineering (runtime lead: Carlos Mendes), Security (reviewer: Priya Shah). Deliver to marketing only the approved hero set after sign-off.
deliverables: 6 hero screenshots (desktop and mobile crop variants) showing: key creation, ephemeral token example, streaming timeline, tool-call trace, snippet with structured output, error fallback
12 inline snippet thumbnails (code + short caption) sized for docs grid
2 animated GIFs: one 6s streaming timeline, one 5s tool-call lifecycle (request -> tool -> response)
Figma source file with components, export tokens, and page for localization
Microcopy sheet: 40 lines of UI text including button labels, snackbars, error copy, and short accessibility labels
Alt-text and keyboard nav notes (WCAG checklist) for each visual
Design handoff checklist and a one-page readme for engineers about sizes/formats and animation frame rates
acceptance_criteria: All hero images exported in PNG and WebP under 1.2MB (desktop) and 450KB (mobile) with 2x resolution variants
Animated GIFs loop cleanly, under 2MB each and no flashing elements that fail accessibility guidelines
Microcopy is reviewed and approved by PM (Mariela Gomez) and Security (Priya Shah)
Figma file contains named components, export tokens, and a 'DEV-HANDOFF' page with exact export settings
Localization-ready text strings exported as a single CSV and validated for length constraints in fr-FR
Design assets uploaded to Drive and linked in ticket; PR in docs repo references the asset pack
Engineers confirm snippets match the latest SDK surface (link to ENG API surface in dependencies)
